title: Page 10
content_zh:
“他要是有把我当成父亲，就不会做出这种混帐事来！”类德山惊怒得胸口急促起伏。

“想来二弟也是一时胡涂，才会做出这样的错事，爹莫为了这种事气坏身子。”娄梓修赶紧劝了句，以彰显自己这个兄长对弟弟的维护之情，与对父亲的孝心。

娄德山如今被嫡子做出的逆伦之事，气得无法平静下来，摆摆手，示意他退下。

如今用不着再将嫡子叫来，他也知道那赖川指证他买凶杀妹之事，不是胡乱指认，女儿的死他虽有些惋惜，但相比起来，儿子更为重要，他不能让这唯一的嫡子赔进去。

半晌，冷静下来后，娄德山交代心腹手下一件事，不久，伍姨娘便在她房里暴毙身亡，而后他打算命人暗中将桂婶处置了，不让这事被泄 露出去，不料那被暂时关押起来的桂婶竟失踪了。

苏云城外。

“回乡后，您就莫再来苏云城了。”寒招财下了路家的马车，上前送别桂婶。

“四姑娘不在了，这儿已没有我惦念的人，往后我不会再来了。”桂婶感激的看着她，“寒姑娘，多谢你，四姑娘的就交给你了。”能做的她都做了，其它的她也无能为力。

但最教她失望的，却是老爷为了掩盖二少爷所做的恶行，竟想悄悄处死她，多亏寒姑娘和路少东家事先安排人悄悄潜进娄家，及时将她救出来，她才能保住一命。

寒招财含笑允诺，“接下来的事交给我，您放心走吧，一路保重。”

桂婶点点头，坐上路家为她准备的另一辆马车离去。

直到马车走远，寒招财才旋过身子，就见路挽风不知何时骑着一匹马来了。

他翻身下马，将缰绳丢给随从，来到她身边，牵起她的手，一块进了她先前乘坐的那辆马车。

“看着桂婶那么伤心的离去，真是不忍心。”她将下颚轻靠在他肩上吸息道。

“至少她知晓了真相。”

“或许她不知道能好过一些。”想到另一件事，她抬眸问他，“你都安排好了？”

“一切都依咱们的计划讲行，不久娄梓纲便会为他所犯下的罪行，付出应有的代价。”等这事了结之后，她就能安心等着做他的新娘。媒人不久前带着她的庚帖回来，祖母命人拿去合了他们俩的八字，如今已在准备下聘之事。

“娄德山千方百计想保住儿子，届时怕是会很失望吧。”她其实并不讨厌娄德山，只是当他得儿子所做的事后，不仅没为女儿的死讨回公道，还选择替儿子遮掩，实在令人心寒。

“娄梓纲自己造的孽，自己得承担起一切。”

“没错，天作孽犹可恕，但自作孽不可活。|

数日之后，娄德山千方百计想隐瞒的事，还是传得满城皆知，这事甚至传到皇宫里去。

皇帝得知事，特命刑部官员前来苏云城调查。

刑部重审娄竹心一案，提讯赖川和娄家庄子里所有的仆人，冬菊等人也被一并提审，最后查问出冬菊等人当时为脱罪，与庄子里的人串通，编造出娄竹心是独自前去池边赏月，不慎失足溺死之事。

实情是他们翌日四处找不到娄竹心，才在池子里发现她的尸体，至于她为何会死在池子里，无人知晓。

这番供词与赖川所供一致，最后将娄梓纲拘来讯问，在刑部官员的手段下，他终于坦承不讳。

皇帝下旨斥责娄家教子无方，纵儿杀妹，还为其隐蔽罪行，毫无仁义之心，拔除娄家皇商的身分。

此事在苏云城沸沸扬扬，直到路挽风即将成婚的喜讯传开来，才渐渐平息，城国百姓转而议论起路挽将迎娶的新娘是何方人氏，讨论最热烈的是她能不能撑到大婚之日，不被路挽风克死。

两个月后，当新郎官领着新娘的花轿绕街，喜炮炸得苏云城热闹一片，沿路围观的百姓，纷纷朝着骑在骏马上的新郎官道喜，恭喜声不绝于耳。

抱着甫出生四天的女儿，寒招财靠坐在床榻上，一双细长的眼微微眯起。

“爹和祖母答应让我给囡囡取名，你说我取的这名字有哪里不好？”

“这名字不太雅。”路挽风委婉的表示希望妻子能再换一个，免得女儿将来长大会怨他们。

她娇嗔，“你是不是觉得这名字俗气？我跟你说，越俗的名字才越好养活，将来才能平平安安长大，而且我叫招财，她叫进宝，人家一听我和她的名字，就知道我们俩是母女，多吉祥的好名字，还能替路家招来更多的财宝，不好吗？”

路家已是家财贯，实在不需再取这样的名字来锦添花，招财进宝，没人能所得出这是一对母女的名字，但这种实话，路挽风不好对刚生下孩子不久的妻子说，免得激怒她。

见妻子执意要为女儿取这个名字，他只得妥协，搂住她们母女，“对我而言，路家的财宝再多，都没有你和女儿重要。”

这话哄得寒招财笑得甜滋滋的。

日月轮换，时光如梭，眨眼间，当年的小女婴已有五岁。

这日她来找父亲，拽着父亲的手，抬起小脸，可怜兮兮的问：“爹，我能换个名字吗？”

“这是为什么？”

“有人笑话我，说我的名字土。”

“是爹对不起你，当年爹没能拦住你娘，她非要为你取这名字，爹也没办法。”路挽风带着歉疚的看着女儿，抱起她安抚。

小姑娘扁着嘴想哭时，听见屋里传来一声脆亮的叫声——

“进宝，快来陪你弟弟升官和发财玩。”

她连忙爬下父亲的怀抱，迈着两条小短腿，咚咚咚朝母亲和两个孪生弟弟飞快跑过去。

在床边，看着床榻上那两个长得一模一样的小团子，她转眼间忘了名字的事，抬起小手戳着他们白白嫩嫩的脸颊，和弟弟们玩得咯咯咯笑了起来。

路挽风跟着走进屋里，满脸温柔。

叫什么名字又何妨，一家子能平平安安，欢欢喜喜守在一起，才是最重要的。

升官和发财，希望将来你们别怪爹，爹真的曾尽力劝阻你们的娘为你们取这名字。

【全书完】

注：相关书籍推荐：

1、月亮升起时之一《村花有财气》；

2、月亮升起时之二《密探有点忙》；

3、月亮升起时之三《镇店女朝奉》。

借尸还魂故事的各种花样 香弥

这个故事算是借尸还魂的一种，不过这本的女主角最后有再回到自己原本的身体里，因与一般重生的故事不太一样。

《喜床上的陌生人》这本也是离魂的故事，不过女主角并未附身到其它人身上，她的魂魄是被男主角的父亲不小心招过去，之后跟在男主角身边，暂时成为阿飘，当然最后她有回到自已原本的身体里。

除非是肉体跟着一起穿越，否则一般的穿越，通常也都属于借尸还魂的一种，有一部分重生的故事也算是。

说起来借尸还魂这个梗，历史很悠久，在古代的一些搜奇志怪小说就有记载。

我在网上查到有一个是被载入正史的故事，时间是发生在金世宗时期，有一个官员写了一封奏折给皇帝，向他禀告一件奇怪的事情。

燕京宛平县有个叫张孝善的农民，他有个儿子叫张合得，这个儿子在三月初一病死，结果当天晚上竟然又复苏。

离奇的是，他醒来之后说自己不是张合得，而是良乡人民王建的儿子王喜儿，吵要去找自己的亲生父亲。

"If he had regarded me as his father, he wouldn't have done such a bastard thing!" Lei Deshan was so frightened and angry that his chest heaved rapidly.

"I think the second brother was also confused for a moment, so he did such a wrong thing. Dad, please don't get angry because of this kind of thing." Lou Zixiu quickly advised him to show his elder brother's protective feelings for his younger brother and his filial piety towards his father.

Lou Deshan was so angry that he couldn't calm down because of the unethical things done by his legitimate son. He waved his hand to signal him to retreat.

Now there is no need to call the legitimate son here. He also knows that Laichuan's accusation that he paid to murder his sister was not a random accusation. Although he regrets his daughter's death, his son is more important in comparison. He cannot let his only legitimate son pay the penalty.

After calming down for a while, Lou Deshan told his confidants something. Soon, Aunt Wu suddenly died in her room. Then he planned to order someone to deal with Aunt Gui secretly to prevent the matter from being leaked. Unexpectedly, Aunt Gui, who was temporarily imprisoned, disappeared.

Outside Suyun City.

"After you return home, you will not come to Suyuncheng again." Han Zhaocai got off the Lu family's carriage and stepped forward to say goodbye to Aunt Gui.

"The fourth girl is gone. There is no one here that I miss. I will not come here again." Aunt Gui looked at her gratefully, "Miss Han, thank you very much. I will leave the fourth girl's affairs to you." She did everything she could, and there was nothing else she could do.

But what disappointed her the most was that in order to cover up the evil deeds committed by the second young master, the master actually wanted to execute her quietly. Thanks to Miss Han and Lu Shaodong's family who arranged for someone to sneak into the Lou's house in advance and rescue her in time, she was able to save her life.

Han Zhaocai promised with a smile, "Leave the rest to me. Please feel free to go and take care along the way."

Aunt Gui nodded, got on another carriage prepared for her by the Lu family, and left.

It wasn't until the carriage was far away that Han Zhaocai turned around and saw Lu Wanfeng riding a horse out of nowhere.

He dismounted, threw the reins to his entourage, came to her side, took her hand, and got into the carriage she had been riding in together.

"I can't bear to see Aunt Gui leave so sadly." She leaned her chin lightly on his shoulder and breathed.

"At least she knows the truth."

"Maybe she doesn't know how to feel better." Thinking of another thing, she raised her eyes and asked him, "Have you made arrangements?"

"Everything will go according to our plan. Soon Lou Zigang will pay the due price for the crimes he committed." After this matter is over, she can wait to be his bride with peace of mind.The matchmaker came back not long ago with her Geng Tie, and my grandmother ordered someone to take it and combine their horoscopes. Now she is preparing for the appointment.

"Lou Deshan tried every means to keep his son, I'm afraid he will be very disappointed." She actually didn't hate Lou Deshan, but after what he did to get his son, he not only failed to seek justice for his daughter's death, but also chose to cover up for his son, which is really chilling.

"Lou Zigang has to bear all the sins he has done himself."

"Yes, you can forgive the sins committed by God, but you cannot live if you do the sins yourself. |

A few days later, the news that Lou Deshan tried every possible means to conceal was spread throughout the city, and even reached the palace.

When the emperor learned of the incident, he specially ordered officials from the Criminal Department to come to Su Yuncheng to investigate.

The Ministry of Punishment re-examined the case of Lou Zhuxin and interrogated Lai Chuan and all the servants in the Lou family's village. Dong Ju and others were also interrogated. In the end, it was found that Dong Ju and others, in order to get away with the crime, colluded with the people in the village to fabricate the story that Lou Zhuxin went to the pool to admire the moon alone, accidentally slipped and drowned.

The truth is that they found Lou Zhuxin's body in the pool the next day after they couldn't find her anywhere. As for why she died in the pool, no one knew.

This confession was consistent with what Laichuan had given, and Lou Zigang was finally detained for questioning. With the help of officials from the Ministry of Punishments, he finally confessed.

The emperor issued an edict to rebuke the Lou family for their failure to educate their children, allowing their children to kill their sisters, concealing their crimes, showing no sense of benevolence and righteousness, and expelling the Lou family from their status as royal merchants.

This matter was aroused in Suyun City. It was not until the good news that Lu Wanfeng was about to get married spread that it gradually subsided. The people in the city turned to discuss the family name of the bride Lu Wanfeng was going to marry. The most heated discussion was whether she could survive until the wedding day without being defeated by Lu Wanfeng.

Two months later, when the groom led the bride's sedan around the street, Suyun City was bustling with wedding cannons. People watching along the road congratulated the groom on his horse, and the sound of congratulations could not be heard.

Holding his four-day-old daughter in his arms, Han Zhaocai sat on the bed and narrowed his slender eyes slightly.

"My father and grandmother agreed to let me name my daughter. What do you think is wrong with the name I chose?"

"It's not an elegant name." Lu Wanfeng expressed tactfully that he hoped his wife could have another wife, so that his daughter would not blame them when she grows up.

She said coquettishly, "Do you think this name is tacky?Let me tell you, the more vulgar the name, the better the income will be, and you will be able to grow up safely in the future. Moreover, my name is Zhaocai, and her name is Jinbao. When people hear my and her names, they will know that we are mother and daughter. What an auspicious name, and it can bring more treasures to the Lu family, isn't it?"

The Lu family is already very wealthy, and there is really no need to choose such a name to add to the splendor and attract wealth. No one would know that these are the names of a mother and daughter. However, Lu Wanfeng cannot tell this truth to his wife who has just given birth to a child, lest she anger her.

Seeing that his wife insisted on choosing this name for his daughter, he had no choice but to compromise and hugged their mother and daughter, "To me, no matter how many treasures the Lu family has, they are not as important as you and my daughter."

These words made Han Zhaocai smile sweetly.

The sun and the moon rotate, time flies, and in the blink of an eye, the little baby girl was already five years old.

That day she came to see her father, held his hand, raised her little face, and asked pitifully: "Dad, can I change my name?"

"why is that?"

"Some people laughed at me and said my name was stupid."

"Dad is sorry for you. He couldn't stop your mother back then. She insisted on giving you this name, and there was nothing he could do."Lu Wanfeng looked at his daughter apologetically, picked her up and comforted her.

When the little girl flattened her mouth and wanted to cry, she heard a crisp cry coming from the room——

"Jinbao, come and play with your brother to get promoted and make a fortune."

She quickly climbed down from her father's arms and ran towards her mother and two twin brothers with her short legs.

Beside the bed, looking at the two little dumplings who looked exactly the same on the bed, she forgot their names in the blink of an eye, raised her little hand to poke their white and tender cheeks, and started giggling while playing with her brothers.

Lu Wanfeng followed him into the house, his face full of gentleness.

It doesn't matter what the name is, the most important thing is that the family can be safe and stay together happily.

I hope you won't blame your father for getting promoted and getting rich in the future. He really tried his best to dissuade your mother from choosing this name for you.

【Complete book】

Note: Recommended related books:

1. When the Moon Rises - "Village Flowers Have Wealth";

2. When the Moon Rises Part 2 "The Secret Agent is a Little Busy";

3. When the Moon Rises Part 3 "The Female Court of the Zhendian".

Various tricks of the corpse-resurrection story, Kaoruya

This story can be regarded as a kind of rebirth, but the heroine in this book finally returns to her original body, which is different from ordinary rebirth stories.

"Stranger on the Wedding Bed" is also a story about a departed soul, but the heroine did not possess anyone else. Her soul was accidentally summoned by the hero's father, and then followed the hero, temporarily becoming Piao. Of course, she eventually returned to her original body.

Unless the body travels along with it, ordinary time travel is usually a kind of resurrection, and some stories of rebirth can also be considered.

Speaking of the idea of reviving a dead body, it has a long history, and is recorded in some ancient novels about searching for strange things.

I found a story on the Internet that was recorded in official history. It happened during the reign of Jin Shizong. An official wrote a memorial to the emperor, reporting a strange thing to him.

There was a farmer named Zhang Xiaoshan in Wanping County, Yanjing. He had a son named Zhang Hede. This son died of illness on the first day of March, but he revived that night.

The strange thing is that after he woke up, he said that he was not Zhang Hede, but Wang Xi'er, the son of Wang Jian, a people in Liangxiang, and he wanted to find his biological father.
